'''Giuseppe Basini''' (10 February 1947 – 9 May 2025) was an Italian politician. A member of the [[National Alliance (Italy)|National Alliance]], the [[Italian Liberal Party (1997)|Italian Liberal Party]], and the [[Lega Nord]], he served in the [[Senate of the Republic (Italy)|Senate of the Republic]] from 1996 to 2001<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.senato.it/leg/13/BGT/Schede/Attsen/00003896.htm|title=Giuseppe BASINI|work=Senate of the Republic|language=Italian}}</ref> and the [[Chamber of Deputies (Italy)|Chamber of Deputies]] from 2018 to 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.camera.it/leg18/29?tipoAttivita=&tipoVisAtt=&tipoPersona=&shadow_deputato=200049&idLegislatura=18|title=BASINI Giuseppe - LEGA|work=Chamber of Deputies|language=Italian}}</ref>

Basini died on 9 May 2025, at the age of 78.<ref>{{cite news |last=Battisti|first=Eugenio|date=9 May 2025|title=Addio a Giuseppe Basini: grande fisico e politico di razza. Fu tra i fondatori di An. Il cordoglio di FdI|url=https://www.secoloditalia.it/2025/05/addio-a-giuseppe-basini-grande-fisico-e-politico-di-razza-fu-tra-i-fondatori-di-an-il-cordoglio-di-fdi/|trans-title= |work=[[Secolo d'Italia]]|language=Italian|location= |publisher= |access-date=27 May 2025}}</ref>
